WITH station_averages AS (
  SELECT
    o.observstation,
    o.lunarstage,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
  FROM observatories AS o
  JOIN telescopes AS t
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage
), phase_summary AS (
  SELECT
    lunarstage,
    AVG(avg_bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct,
    COUNT(*) AS station_count
  FROM station_averages
  GROUP BY lunarstage
)
SELECT
  lunarstage,
  avg_bandusagepct,
  station_count,
  CAST(station_count AS REAL) / SUM(station_count) OVER () AS station_fraction
FROM phase_summary;
